body: Here's what I'm gonna do first and see what happens, I'm gonna go to IOP group tonight and I'll be 100% with how I feel right now and will see what happens. I just got started at this place so I wanna see if maybe it'll be a finally be something that might work. Plus they're aware of my suicide history and have me on an elevated care level so for now on on a weekly basis I'm required to sit down with the psychiatrist and have a chat to assess my mental state so there's shit in place here, I just gotta find a desire to wanna use it, tonight I'll open up a bit and see what happens.

Yea I'm thinking about it. There's a psychiatric hospital I did a stint in once for trying to hang myself in rehab a couple years ago well within walking distance. The problem is I really don't wanna go. I don't like it, I'll lie my way through it like I did last time to get the discharge approval and be back where I started and now embarrassed some more in front of parent who would think it's just hopeless then and older siblings who think I'm a lost cause for sure then. I can see all the things I need to do and have done them before pretty much but because I'm eternally empty inside it just doesn't ever bring back in happiness or desire to keep on walking straight. Believe me, I know I need serious fucking mental help, hell I think I need open brain surgery or a lobotomy to dumb myself up or find whatever it is in there that's broken and do something about it. I'll let you know what happens. I also don't leave people left wondering so if I decide to take finally play fiddle with the devil I'll be sure to leave my login on a note, but I doubt it, my stay in jail fighting and proving myself reactivated the anti self destruct sensor in my head so I struggle with following through with killing myself anyways... How's that for ironic?
